# IGV assets — PerR ChIP-exo

*Auto-generated by `workflow/rules/igv.smk` on 2026-08-09. Do not edit — regenerated every run.*

## Which tracks to use

| | `full_depth/` | `depth_matched/` |
|---|---|---|
| Reads | every read | subsampled to a common depth |
| **Use for** | **browsing, and any single-strain figure** | **only figures making an explicit A909-vs-CJB111 claim** |
| Why | maximum sensitivity; nothing is discarded | equal depth so peak counts are comparable |

**Full depth is the default.** Depth-matching exists to make *peak counts* comparable between strains; for looking at signal at a locus it discards ~57% of A909's reads and 23 of its 87 events for no benefit. Use it only when unequal depth would otherwise confound a comparison you are making.

```
IGV  ->  File  ->  Open Session  ->  <one of the files below>
```

## Track order in every session

| # | Track | Colour | Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | IP forward 5′ | blue | 0–20 |
| 2 | IP reverse 5′ | red | 0–20 (or −20–0 mirrored) |
| 3 | no-tag control | grey | 0–20 |
| 4 | ChExMix peaks (full depth) | slate | — |
| 5 | peaks surviving the depth match | slate | — |
| 6 | GBS PerR motif, FIMO p<1e−4 | rust | — |
| 7 | GAS Per box (reference only) | grey-blue | — |
| 8 | direct regulon genes | rust / teal | — |
| 9 | RefSeq genes | dark grey | — |

**The control track is never omitted.** A peak shown without a flat control beneath it is not evidence, and it is the first thing a sceptical reader looks for.

## How the coverage was built

- **Signal**: 5′-end only (the exonuclease stop / crosslink). In ChIP-exo the 5′ end of R1 *is* the exonuclease stop, i.e. the footprint border.
- **Strand split**: R1 only — forward = `--samFlagInclude 64 --samFlagExclude 16`, reverse = `--samFlagInclude 80`. R2 does not carry the border.
- **Bin size**: 1 bp. A footprint is tens of bp; binning would smear it.
- **Normalisation**: one CPM-equivalent scale factor computed from the **unfiltered** merged BAM and applied to both strands.

> **Why that last point matters.** Asking deepTools for CPM *after* filtering to one strand computes the scale factor from that subset, so the two strands land on different scales and the footprint looks asymmetric when it is not. Sharing one scale factor makes them comparable by construction.

## Finding a gene

```bash
grep -i 'YOUR_GENE' results/10_igv/loci/A909.loci.tsv | cut -f2,3,4,5,11,12
grep -i 'YOUR_GENE' results/10_igv/loci/CJB111.loci.tsv | cut -f2,3,4,5,11,12
```
Paste `igv_context` (gene ±750 bp — the default view) or `igv_zoom` (TSS ±250 bp — resolves the strand doublet) into IGV's location box.

The zoom window centres on the **TSS**, not the gene midpoint: PerR is a repressor, so the binding that matters is at the promoter — which for minus-strand genes is the gene *end*.

## Headless snapshots

```bash
xvfb-run -a igv.sh --batch results/10_igv/batch/A909_full_depth_panels.bat
```
The batch script **loads the session first**, so ranges and colours come from the XML — batch scripts cannot set those, and loading tracks individually would silently lose every display setting.

## Reading the panels — caveats

- **The motif track is empty at *perR*.** Neither peak carries a detectable Per box. That is a finding, not a broken track.
- **CJB111 looks weaker than A909.** Genuine: half-scale bead/antibody prep, signal fraction 0.159 vs 0.273. Keep the shared range and say so in the legend.
- **Per-site FIMO q-values are ~0.6–1.0** and must never be quoted. The claim is co-localization and central enrichment (median offset −2 bp), not per-site significance.
- **The rRNA-operon peak is annotated, not excluded.** It is the only one of 87 touching any rRNA operon or tRNA, so there is no systematic artefact and an exclusion list would remove almost nothing while looking like post-hoc filtering.

## Figure legends must state

1. Which tracks (depth, 5′-end only, R1 strand-split, CPM-equivalent scaling)
2. **That data ranges are identical across compared panels** — the point reviewers check
3. That the control is the matched no-tag sample
4. Genome build accessions: A909 GCF_000012705.1, CJB111 GCF_015221735.2
5. Coordinates for every panel

## Regenerate

```bash
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 igv              # everything
snakemake --sdm conda -c8 igv_full_depth   # full-depth assets only
```
